subject: Solstice Health — Week 0 kickoff: scheduling, roster & links

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 18 Sep 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Solstice Health - Week 0 kickoff: proposed windows & attendees

Hi Dana,

Excited to get Week 0 on the calendar. To make scheduling quick, here are three proposed kickoff windows (all PT):

- Option A: Tue 24 Sep, 10:00 - 11:15 AM PT
- Option B: Wed 25 Sep, 1:30 - 2:45 PM PT
- Option C: Thu 26 Sep, 8:30 - 9:45 AM PT

Agenda (high level):
- 10m: intros + success criteria
- 20m: rollout milestones & ownership
- 25m: environment/access checklist (SSO, network, dataset access)
- 15m: immediate next steps & responsibilities

Ask: can you confirm which option fits your team and which attendees from Solstice should join (business sponsor, IT lead, SRE/infra)? We suggest the list below for Redwood: Monica (onboarding lead), Marissa (technical PM), Jonas (solutions engineer).

Attached: draft Kickoff-Agenda-v0.1.pdf for your review.

If any of those windows don't work, send a couple alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward,

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0124

Thanks Karthik — quick note from our side.

We have a company holiday on Wed 25th (observed), so Option B won't work. Option A looks promising; Option C is tight for our East Coast folks (would be late for them).

Proposed attendees:
- Dana Cho — Program Sponsor
- Priya Reddy — Director, IT (SSO/network owner)
- Aaron Li — Infra Lead (will validate firewall/egress needs)

We also want a short pre-call for SSO owners if any network work is needed; Aaron can join a 30-min slot next Monday (30 Sep) morning PT if that helps.

Can you confirm final time and send an invite with Zoom?

Cheers,
Dana

—
